info.name: SAML Provider
info.summary: Use Nextcloud as a SAML 2.0 Identity Provider (IdP)
info.description:
This app turns Nextcloud into a SAML 2.0 Identity Provider so external services (Service Providers) can authenticate against your Nextcloud user base via SSO.
Features: * SAML 2.0 Web Browser SSO profile (HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings) * SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO * Single Logout (SLO) endpoint * Signed AuthnResponses and Assertions (RSA-SHA256) * Optional verification of signed AuthnRequests per Service Provider * Per-Service-Provider configuration (ACS URL, EntityID, attribute mapping, NameID format) * IdP metadata endpoint for easy SP onboarding * App launcher page listing all enabled Service Providers for users
info.author: SAML Provider for Nextcloud contributors
